# Tracking Requirements Quality Checklist: Incident Status Tracking Timeline

**Purpose**: Validate that the tracking-timeline + arrival requirements are complete, clear, consistent, measurable, and coverage-sufficient before implementation review
**Created**: 2026-11-09
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are all canonical lifecycle stages explicitly enumerated (Reported, Assigned, Responding, Arrived, Resolved, Declined)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the `arrived` event's relationship to the top-level status explicitly defined (event, not a status value)? [Completeness, Spec §Key Entities]
- [ ] CHK003 Are the data elements recorded per transition (from/to status, timestamp, actor, context) fully specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK004 Are all surfaces that render incident details enumerated so none can be missed? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK005 Are requirements defined for who may press Arrived (assignee-only, in-progress-only)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the manual-arrival authorization boundary (admin/dispatcher only, no responder self-override) explicitly documented? [Completeness, Spec §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the responder pin's visibility window defined (active states only, removed on terminal/cleared)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK008 Is "current step" precisely defined (how it's derived when arrived rows exist but report is still in-progress)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the arrival radius quantified with a default and an adjustable mechanism rather than a vague "close"? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK010 Are all disabled-reason cases for Arrived enumerated (too far, GPS off, denied, no incident coords, accuracy worse than radius)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK011 Is "skipped step" rendering defined concretely (which steps can be skipped, how they appear)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK012 Is "Unverified/insufficient data" behavior for legacy reports specified without fabricating times? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK013 Are timeline contents consistent across roles (same steps/timestamps everywhere) per FR-006 without role-specific divergence? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK014 Does "Arrived optional" in FR-001 stay consistent with the skipped-step handling in FR-008? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001/FR-008]
- [ ] CHK015 Are declined-presentation requirements consistent with the pin-visibility rules (both treat declined as terminal)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009/FR-015]
- [ ] CHK016 Do the assignment/reassignment requirements avoid duplicated assign steps consistently? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the proximity gate consistent between client display and server enforcement (server is authoritative)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-012, Contract rpc.md]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK018 Are requirements defined for each role's primary tracking flow (resident, responder, dispatcher/admin)? [Coverage, Spec §User Stories]
- [ ] CHK019 Are requirements defined for the no-transitions-yet state (just filed)? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK020 Are requirements defined for realtime unavailability (stale render + recovery)? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK021 Are requirements defined for out-of-order transitions (pending → resolved, resolved without arrive)? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK022 Are requirements defined for concurrent/double arrival attempts? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK023 Is the declined terminal-state presentation fully specified (distinct from resolved)? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK024 Is GPS-unavailable/denied handling specified for both the button and the resident map? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-013, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK025 Is the legacy-report (no recorded transitions) rendering path specified? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK026 Is reassignment's effect on both timeline and Arrived eligibility specified? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK027 Is stale/frozen responder-pin behavior on the resident map specified (offline cue, removal on terminal)? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK028 Are visibility/authorization requirements for the responder pin explicit (reporter + authorized staff only)? [Security, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK029 Is the realtime update latency target specified (≤5 s without reload)? [Performance, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK030 Is GPS freshness quantified (≤15 s stale at display)? [Performance, Spec §SC-008]
- [ ] CHK031 Are accessibility requirements specified for the timeline/buttons (44 px, contrast, Esc)? [Accessibility, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK032 Are security requirements stated for who can write history rows (no direct client writes)? [Security, Spec §FR-005, data-model.md]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK033 Can "0% outside-radius arrivals succeed" be objectively verified? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]
- [ ] CHK034 Can "status change visible ≤5 s" be objectively measured across all surfaces? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK035 Can "resident answers 'where is it now' in 10 s" be operationally tested? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK036 Is 100% surface coverage (SC-001) verifiable with an enumerated list? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK037 Is the existing in-app notification path documented as a dependency of FR-014? [Dependency, Spec §FR-014/Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK038 Is the live-schema caveat (migrations not guaranteed applied) captured for planning? [Dependency, plan.md Constitution Check]
- [ ] CHK039 Is the assumption that responder live-location is already shared validated in the spec? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK040 Is the radius default choice (50 m over 5 m) and its GPS-error rationale documented? [Assumption, Spec §Clarifications]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK041 Is "arrived" terminology used consistently (event vs status vs step label) across spec sections? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-011/014]
- [ ] CHK042 Are there no conflicting statements about who sees the live pin (staff vs resident vs public)? [Conflict, Spec §FR-015/016]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit.implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit.specify` and `/speckit.clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
